crossRefs.note: Israel sent messengers to Sihon king of the Amorites, saying,
I sent messengers out of the wilderness of Kedemoth to Sihon king of Heshbon with words of peace, saying,
Then we turned, and went up the way to Bashan. Og the king of Bashan came out against us, he and all his people, to…
With him the Reubenites and the Gadites received their inheritance, which Moses gave them, beyond the Jordan eastward…

people.name: Amorites
people.line: Canaanite people group, enemies of Israel

people.name: Heshbon
people.line: Amorite city conquered by Moses, allotted to Reuben

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Sihon
people.line: Amorite king of Heshbon, defeated by the Israelites.

translations.web: Israel sent messengers to Sihon king of the Amorites, the king of Heshbon; and Israel said to him, ‘Please let us pass through your land to my place.’
translations.bsb: And Israel sent messengers to Sihon king of the Amorites, who ruled in Heshbon, and said to him, ‘Please let us pass through your land into our own place.’
translations.kjv: And Israel sent messengers unto Sihon king of the Amorites, the king of Heshbon; and Israel said unto him, Let us pass, we pray thee, through thy land into my place.
translations.asv: And Israel sent messengers unto Sihon king of the Amorites, the king of Heshbon; and Israel said unto him, Let us pass, we pray thee, through thy land unto my place.
